title: SCHC draft contradicts 23,562-byte profile ceiling with obsolete 12 KB limit
description: spec/drafts/draft-lichen-schc-lora-00.md Section 5.1 defines an optional encoding ceiling of 126*187=23,562 bytes and requires sender knowledge of receiver capacity, but Section 5.4 later says max practical IPv6 datagram ~12 KB and packets larger than that MUST be application-chunked. The conflicting normative MUST can make conforming implementations reject valid provisioned profile-capacity transfers and disagrees with spec/03-adaptation.md plus schc_fragmentation.json profile_capacity. Remove the obsolete 12 KB requirement or align it exactly with the 23,562-byte ceiling and 1,281-byte mandatory receiver minimum; add/retain cross-reference to capacity vectors.
